p.d: The Power of Us. Danger looms in Fula City, and Ash, Pikachu and their new friends fight to save the day.
A Hole Lot of Trouble. When rain derails an outside game of catch, someone suggests they play it inside.
A Tall Tale. After Owen's BBF, Noah, goes through a growth spurt, Owen fears losing his friend.
Welcome to Paldea! Back in Paldea, the time has come for Liko to part ways with the Rising Volt Tacklers.
She Sees Sea Monster at the Sea Shore. The gang's tropical island vacation gets ruined when they stumble across a sea monster.
It's Time to Build a Nest. JoJo and Gran Gran spot a bird's nest, and Daddy teaches JoJo how to whistle like a bird.
Friendly Flynne. Flynne helps Oona find Mossy, and proves she can be a friendly fox.
It Wasn't Me! Animation in which a pair of siblings deal with everyday topics. Lola's imaginary friend persuades her to borrow Charlie's rocket to take an elephant to the jungle.
Lily Plant's Lovely Day. In the Toy House, each of the friends decides to give Lily Plant some 'pretend water'.
Purple Ducky. MeMo and BaBa play with a new toy at the Play Tree. When the toy breaks, MeMo wants to find another toy, but BaBa shows MeMo that there are other ways to play.
The Pontipine Children on the Roof. In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures. The Pontipines ride on the Ninky Nonk. Mr and Mrs Pontipine can't find the children.
James Norton - How to Manage a Mammoth. James Norton reads a very special story, about a little boy with a mammoth problem that he learns to manage.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Baby Jake Loves Bouncing Apples. The adventures of magical Baby Jake and friends. Baby Jake and Nibbles the Rabbit go on an orchard adventure and enjoy bouncing.
Knack. Sula, Pando, Flop and Padget all have a knack, a special thing that only they can do. Bing is frustrated when all his own knacks are easy for everyone else to do, too.
Water Colours. Tralala is painting in the garden when she finds a lost little cloud in need of care.   Followed by Small Potatoes.
Flappy Snap. Cherry wants to photograph a rare butterfly. The Piggies try to help but get too competitive and scare it away. Now, they must team up to fix their mistake.
Pear. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the fastest woodwind player - Pear!
Pig Gets Big. Felix causes chaos as a giant pig, but Mojo and Bo are right on his huge, curly tail!
Night Moves. When a pipe bursts in the Roundhouse, an exhausted Wilson must roam Chuggington in search of a new cabin to sleep in. But nothing feels quite like home.
Operation Jewel. Supertato is determined to rescue Tomato's precious jewel after Evil Pea steals it.
Dressing Up. Coco discovers Bing's dressing-up box so they both dress up, but there is only one crown and they both need it to complete their outfits.
Nicky. Bing shows Sula's cousin how to voosh a toy car down a slide - but then things go wrong.
The Sleeping Badge. Animated preschool series. Tag can't sleep, so Duggee tells him a few tricks other animals use to get to sleep.
The Brave Banana Badge. Animated preschool series. It's a stormy day, and the Squirrels are scared of lightning. Fortunately, Duggee knows how to help them overcome their fears.
Hungry. Dad is hungry and pretends to eat Bingo.
Loch Ness, Scotland. Animated adventure comedy series. The Go Jetters visit Loch Ness in Scotland. But when Glitch arrives, things soon go from Nessie to messy.
The Tale of the Great Tortoise Rescue. Animated series. When Peter accidentally sends a sleeping Mr Tolly floating off to Owl Island, he launches a rescue with his friends.
Sea Sponge. Animated deep sea adventures. A sea sponge that houses other sea creatures in its pores suffers from a mysterious illness, and Peso must figure out the cause.
Otto's Fancy Friend. Otto's afraid a caterpillar pal will be too fancy to be friends when she's a butterfly.
Happy Happy Valentine's. Mojo and Bo have to deliver a superfun singing valentine. But the problem is, they don't know who it's for, or who it's from. Preston is racing to beat them to it!
Old Fashioned. Joe will be taking you through the classics. There are squats, star jumps and push-ups in the Old-Fashioned Challenge. Help him bring the colour back with this Activate!
Back in Time. Justin and his friends step back in time, and Mr Tumble has some clock trouble.
Hide-and-Seek. It's time for a family game of hide-and-seek.
Obstacle Course. Mum and the kids set up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race!
The Sewing Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee and the Squirrels are sewing ponchos when they hear a loud sneeze. Someone needs a hanky - what could they use instead?
The Surprise Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee and the Squirrels have bought Hennie a present for her birthday. But before they surprise her, they need to wrap it up.
Gadabout Blabbermouth. Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles, but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.
Penguin Games. When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.
The Yes Day Wish. It's Yes Day, so Dash and Jake say yes to everything Rafi asks - until she realises that doing less can sometimes mean you enjoy it more.
Mission Shopping. The freight train is here! Weasy wants to go shopping, but the ducklings want to play with their teddies. They secretly play while Weasy shops.
Tiny Car Caper/Tooth Fairy Tricks. Zola shrinks cars. Rhino learns about the tooth fairy.
Puffin Colony. Peso and Kwazii incubate a puffin egg while the Octonauts search for its missing parents.
Mission: Disco Party Pooper. Silver Paw plots to ruin the kids' disco, so Deena must learn to dance to save the day.
Hibernation. Ginger and the Pea-Rexes accidentally wake up a Kiwimammuthus during a snowball fight.
Evil Pea Takes a Break. Evil Pea's spa break is ruined when the Cobs try to trick Supertato while she's gone.
Episode 13. Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Things get messy for Storybook Stan when he reads a story about a sunny tropical island.
The Poster Competition. The class enters a poster contest to encourage the town to become more green. Dodge's group have lots of ideas but are struggling to decide on just one.
Marian's Bulgarian Gyuveche. Marian's gyuveche is made using layers of peppers, tomatoes and feta with an egg on top.
Shady Plants. Aaron, Nelly and Adrian explore the wonderful world of plants that live in the shade, with some help from resident shady plant, Fearny the fern.
Recycling Day. Recycling day in the attic inspires several great makes. A pot becomes a hairdo, cheese boxes become octopuses and buttons become a brilliant box robot.
Explorers. Miss Hoolie and the nursery children are all set for a woodland adventure with Dr Ollie, but when a gust of wind rips a hole in his map, Ollie has to find a back-up.
The Singing Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee and the Squirrels go for a walk in the countryside. It's tiring, but if they sing a song, they'll be back before they know it.
Octonauts and the Emperor Penguins. Animation. The Octonauts journey across a dangerous expanse of ice to help a penguin mother get back to her family.
Zigzag's Skunk Spray. When Zigzag's skunk friend accidentally sprays her, she tries everything to get rid of the smell. Luckily, Vida knows just what to do!
The Salmon Run, Alaska. Glitch sets up an ill-fated 'fishy taxi service' to help the salmon run in Alaska.
When Dad Got the Hiccups. Dad gets a severe case of Proximan hiccups. Big Lizard and Cosima do their best to help, but their attempt to scare Dad goes wrong when a real 'monster' turns up!
Feels Like Thunder. TipTop is an amazing drummer, and she is deaf too. She helps Yukee feel the music.
Digging It. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.
Teatime. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble invites Lord Tumble and Aunt Polly for tea. Meanwhile, Justin visits a Caribbean restaurant.
Oak. Sebastian reveals how acorns become oak trees.
Deep Sea Adventure. After diving in Balamory Bay, PC Plum dreams of taking the nursery children underwater.
Fiendish Fergus. Fergus starts acting strangely when he catches beastly blight. The doctors know the cure, but Fergus dismisses their advice in favour of his own muddler traditions.
Bin Night. Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her. Mum offers some good advice.
Hide-and-Seek. It's time for a family game of hide-and-seek.
Losing Things. Pasilio loves to keep lost things, but Tralala knows they need to go back to their owners.
The Baby Wish. Rafi's wish turns her dads into babies. She realises being a grown-up means having responsibility - and that chores can be fun when mixed with dancing.
The Moth and the Sloth. After doing some exercise to start the day, Nick and Norman spot a moth and a sloth and realise that sometimes it's fun to take things nice and slow.
Befriend a Bug Day. It's Befriend a Bug Day, and Love Monster makes friends with some caterpillars who love his beatboxing. But he is mystified when they appear to vanish...
Strange Beds. Live-action children's show. Topsy and Tim can't sleep in the bunk beds as usual because their bedroom is being redecorated by DIY Derek.
Sea Captain. Dylan wants to be the best captain ever, but he soon discovers a sea captain is nothing without his crew!
Flying Cherry. Cherry dreams of soaring through the sky. The Piggies build a plane, but her first flight is a disaster. Cherry begins to doubt herself, but the Piggies won't give up!
Snowbells. It's been snowing in the garden, and Yukee helps Sonny find uses for a large collection of recycled bells.
Wynken, Blynken and Nod. Children's sign language poetry series. Aimee and Ashley discover You Are Old, Father William by Lewis Carroll, and Wynken, Blynken and Nod by Eugene Field.
Madam Dragon Knows Best. Spark isn't feeling well, and Madam Dragon insists she knows what's wrong.
Muffin Cone. Muffin's cone gets in the way of her playing a game of sandwich shop with Bluey and Bingo.
Blocks. Bluey and Bingo build an enormous tower of blocks.

p.t: Pudsey and the Thread of Hope
p.d: Join Pudsey Bear as he takes nine-year-old Jai on a magical adventure of hope and joy.
It's Time for Some Science. It's a rainy day, and JoJo and Isaiah can't decide what to do. Gran Gran has a plan.
It's a Secret. Children's animation featuring a pair of siblings. Lola must keep Charlie's birthday surprise secret, but it is hard to keep secrets when Charlie tries to guess.
Mr Onion's Storybook. Mr Onion looks inside a book and decides to tell a story to his best friend Dibillo.
Matching Game. MeMo and BaBa have fun finding and matching shapes all over Planet BeddyByes. MeMo helps BaBa match the shapes in a picture book when they visit their friends, the Yummies.
Upsy Daisy Dances with the Pinky Ponk. Series for young children. Upsy Daisy shows her love for everything in the garden by dancing. The Pinky Ponk imitates her every move.
Natalie Dormer - Princess Penelope and the Runaway Kitten. A story read by a special guest. Natalie Dormer reads a fun story about a princess and a tiny kitten with a big personality.

p.t: Climate For Change 2: Closing The Loop
p.d: How can a Circular Economy reduce tonnes of food, fashion, electronics and construction waste from ending up in landfills? How can cities unlock lucrative opportunities in closing the resource loop?
From jet sims to sky farms and vanilla vines, we explore Singapore's highs and lows - chasing thrills, meeting dreamers, and finding heart in the streets of Kallang.
Hawkers In Our Centre
Hawkers In Our Centre
Heiress Kathlyn Tan swims against the tide to make oceans clean and vibrant. We discover why she invests her paychecks, and her passion, into tackling issues like overfishing and plastic pollution.
Eight years ago, Kia Jiehui left her father's engineering firm to join an NGO. She's now back with her dad, and with a mission. To green the industry, not just for the environment, but workers too.
Third-generation sugar maker, John Cheng believes there is a strong business case for going green. We follow his journey to revolutionise the food industry, starting with his own business.

p.t: Climate For Change 2: Closing The Loop
p.d: Entrepreneurs are using hi-tech to turn plastic into fuel, or even back into plastic. Others are turning food waste into fuel, or new types of food. And lab-grown meat aims to avoid waste altogether.

This time: Married at First Sight Australia, Wheel of Fortune, The Americas, Fear, Griff's Great Australian Rail Trip, Help! My House Is Haunted and BBC News (Trump vs Zelenskyy).
Twelve years ago, a brain injury turned Ben's world upside down. He worries about how people will react to his condition. His date, Charlotte, also has confidence issues.
A tall, tattooed Brummie hunk meets a lady who likes giants - with tattoos. Anaesthetist David can't remember his date's name. Plus: a couple who have four divorces between them.
It's Britain's Got Talent, Celebrity Hunted and Coronation Street on the 'Box this time. Plus: One Question, Boarders, The Fear Clinic, and Donald Trump on the News.
The One in the Spanish Sea: Carl plans to marry Rebecca on the Med but she's expecting a high-class affair. Will Carl's plans make a splash and make Rebecca swoon with delight?
The Oktoberfest One: Sofia dreams of a boho beach blessing, but Craig wants an Oktoberfest wedding with short leather trousers. Will Sofia end the nuptials?
Adam Spielberg: Adam writes an original script about Indiana Jones, but his passion for directing is challenged when he films it. Barry and Murray make a wager.
While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play. And a couple plan their wedding.
The Scrunchie Rule: Beverly nurses Coach Mellor back to health after a slip-up with rope-climbing equipment. Erica and her roommate begin to annoy each other.
Won't You Be Our Neighbor: Phil is selling the house next door and he and Claire are excited by the prospect of having wonderful new neighbours.
AwesomeLand: Even though Claire usually plans Halloween, she lets Phil take over, and - instead of her usual fright-fest theme - he turns the house into AwesomeLand.
Queer Eyes, Full Hearts: Phil and Claire don't know if they should be happy that Haley and Andy are spending time together. They soon find out that things are not as they appear.
Three Turkeys: Phil is cooking Thanksgiving dinner this year with Luke as his sous chef. But Claire has no confidence in them and prepares a secret turkey of her own as backup.
Mike and Nellie's: In Oakhurst, Gordon Ramsay helps the overwhelmed owner of Mike and Nellie's restaurant, who lost his way when his father and business partner died.
El Greco: Gordon Ramsay visits struggling Greek restaurant El Greco, where the owners have secretly recruited 'Chef Mike' the microwave to help them out on a daily basis.
Wick 'n Ore Kitchen & Tap: Gordon Ramsay's at the coalface in northern Illinois, where a mining-themed restaurant is suffering an identity crisis.
It's a caramel quarter-final, and the bakers make treacle tarts, millionaire shortbread and nougatine showpieces. Who oozes caramel confidence, and who'll crack under pressure?
(2019) Fun-filled family comedy starring John Cena. A macho fireman has to babysit three impish kids after saving them from a blaze in the remote California woodlands.
Mr Plow: Homer impulsively buys a snow plough and sets up in business as Mr Plow. But when Barney declares himself the Plow King, their rivalry spirals out of control.
Lisa's First Word: The family try to get Maggie to say her first word. But Homer's glad that she hasn't spoken yet, because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him.
Homer's Triple Bypass: Homer has a heart attack while he's watching TV. The hospital says he needs a bypass, but Homer can't afford it. Of course, there's always Dr Nick...
Marge vs the Monorail: When Springfield decides to install a monorail system, Homer is employed as the conductor. There's just one problem: he has no idea what he's doing.
Lisa the Tree Hugger: A dramatic rooftop protest at Krusty Burger inspires Lisa to become an eco-radical - especially when she sees how cute one of the protestors is...
Homer vs Dignity: Homer asks Mr Burns for a pay rise after the family have to dress up as a mariachi band and sing for their dinner. But Mr Burns has a better idea...
Treehouse of Horror XI: Homer receives a very scary horoscope, and Bart and Lisa are banished to the forest, where they find a house made of gingerbread...
The Computer Wore Menace Shoes: After Homer publishes damaging rumours on 'Mr X's Web Page', he ends up on a Prisoner-style island, complete with guest star Patrick McGoohan.

Xavier Mufraggi, the CEO of Club Med North America, goes undercover, disguised as a laid-back surfer, in his own resorts, to see the impact that his growth plans are having.

Gordon revisits Café Hon in Baltimore, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in New Jersey, to find out whether the owners have taken his advice on board.
Olde Hitching Post: Gordon visits the historic Olde Hitching Post restaurant in Massachusetts. Tom bought the business for his daughter but refuses to let her run it.
Jimmy Carr hosts, while Jon Richardson and Bob Mortimer take on Sean Lock and Vic Reeves. Jack Whitehall joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner.
...Joe Lycett: In his award-winning stand up show, Joe Lycett lampoons everything from tyrannical Post Office jobsworths to the stupidity of celebrities on Twitter.
Jimmy Carr hosts the topical comedy panel show, with team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock and guests Jo Brand, Ronan Keating, Krishnan Guru-Murthy and James Acaster.
Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy panel show, with team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock and celebrity guests Dr Christian Jessen, Lethal Bizzle, Joe Wilkinson and Aisling Bea.
Marge Gets a Job: When Marge gets a job at the power plant, Mr Burns falls in love with her and invites her over to dinner, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them.
New Kid on the Block: When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court.
(2007) Animated comedy. When Homer's love for a pig causes world-threatening pollution, Springfield gets enclosed in a huge dome. D'oh! Will he do the decent thing and save his neighbours?
Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith get festive with bakers of Christmas past Sophie, Dan, Amelia, Linda, George and Carole, and a performance from the Citizens of the World Choir.
Britain's favourite armchair critics review Christmas TV, from Strictly to Gavin & Stacey, First Dates, Hot Frosty, Bullseye, The Dog House, Is It Cake? and Fanny Cradock.
It's Britain's Got Talent, Celebrity Hunted and Coronation Street on the 'Box this time. Plus: One Question, Boarders, The Fear Clinic, and Donald Trump on the News.
This time: Married at First Sight Australia, Wheel of Fortune, The Americas, Fear, Griff's Great Australian Rail Trip, Help! My House Is Haunted and BBC News (Trump vs Zelenskyy).
Twelve years ago, a brain injury turned Ben's world upside down. He worries about how people will react to his condition. His date, Charlotte, also has confidence issues.
A tall, tattooed Brummie hunk meets a lady who likes giants - with tattoos. Anaesthetist David can't remember his date's name. Plus: a couple who have four divorces between them.
It's Britain's Got Talent, Celebrity Hunted and Coronation Street on the 'Box this time. Plus: One Question, Boarders, The Fear Clinic, and Donald Trump on the News.
The One in the Spanish Sea: Carl plans to marry Rebecca on the Med but she's expecting a high-class affair. Will Carl's plans make a splash and make Rebecca swoon with delight?
The Oktoberfest One: Sofia dreams of a boho beach blessing, but Craig wants an Oktoberfest wedding with short leather trousers. Will Sofia end the nuptials?
Adam Spielberg: Adam writes an original script about Indiana Jones, but his passion for directing is challenged when he films it. Barry and Murray make a wager.
While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play. And a couple plan their wedding.
The Scrunchie Rule: Beverly nurses Coach Mellor back to health after a slip-up with rope-climbing equipment. Erica and her roommate begin to annoy each other.
Won't You Be Our Neighbor: Phil is selling the house next door and he and Claire are excited by the prospect of having wonderful new neighbours.
AwesomeLand: Even though Claire usually plans Halloween, she lets Phil take over, and - instead of her usual fright-fest theme - he turns the house into AwesomeLand.
Queer Eyes, Full Hearts: Phil and Claire don't know if they should be happy that Haley and Andy are spending time together. They soon find out that things are not as they appear.
Three Turkeys: Phil is cooking Thanksgiving dinner this year with Luke as his sous chef. But Claire has no confidence in them and prepares a secret turkey of her own as backup.
Mike and Nellie's: In Oakhurst, Gordon Ramsay helps the overwhelmed owner of Mike and Nellie's restaurant, who lost his way when his father and business partner died.
El Greco: Gordon Ramsay visits struggling Greek restaurant El Greco, where the owners have secretly recruited 'Chef Mike' the microwave to help them out on a daily basis.
Wick 'n Ore Kitchen & Tap: Gordon Ramsay's at the coalface in northern Illinois, where a mining-themed restaurant is suffering an identity crisis.
It's a caramel quarter-final, and the bakers make treacle tarts, millionaire shortbread and nougatine showpieces. Who oozes caramel confidence, and who'll crack under pressure?
(2019) Fun-filled family comedy starring John Cena. A macho fireman has to babysit three impish kids after saving them from a blaze in the remote California woodlands.
Mr Plow: Homer impulsively buys a snow plough and sets up in business as Mr Plow. But when Barney declares himself the Plow King, their rivalry spirals out of control.
Lisa's First Word: The family try to get Maggie to say her first word. But Homer's glad that she hasn't spoken yet, because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him.
Homer's Triple Bypass: Homer has a heart attack while he's watching TV. The hospital says he needs a bypass, but Homer can't afford it. Of course, there's always Dr Nick...
Marge vs the Monorail: When Springfield decides to install a monorail system, Homer is employed as the conductor. There's just one problem: he has no idea what he's doing.
Lisa the Tree Hugger: A dramatic rooftop protest at Krusty Burger inspires Lisa to become an eco-radical - especially when she sees how cute one of the protestors is...
Homer vs Dignity: Homer asks Mr Burns for a pay rise after the family have to dress up as a mariachi band and sing for their dinner. But Mr Burns has a better idea...
Treehouse of Horror XI: Homer receives a very scary horoscope, and Bart and Lisa are banished to the forest, where they find a house made of gingerbread...
The Computer Wore Menace Shoes: After Homer publishes damaging rumours on 'Mr X's Web Page', he ends up on a Prisoner-style island, complete with guest star Patrick McGoohan.

Christmas Eve. Marcus prepares festive favourites to make the night before Christmas, from pollock in a creamy mushroom sauce to green beans in a sweet hazelnut dressing. S1, Ep5
Perfect Christmas Breakfast. Marcus shares his top recipes to get in the festive mood. They include oaty pancakes with compote and the classic Bloody Mary with oysters. S1, Ep6
Christmas Baking. Marcus makes some festive bakes including a decadent salmon Pithivier, a warming ginger cake and a scrumptious citrus enhanced treacle tart. S1, Ep7
Open House Party Food. Marcus shares his favourite festive finger food, from deliciously bite-size donuts to stress-free chicken wings and crispy roast spuds with a trio of dips. S1, Ep8

p.t: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
p.d: How the Formation of Pangea Changed the World: In the Late Carboniferous Period, predatory amphibians and giant arthropods ruled the swamps. (Part 1 of 6) (S)
...Pangea: How Eating Plants Shaped Life on Land: The first herbivorous vertebrates evolve on the side of the amniote family tree leading to mammals. (Part 2 of 6) (S)
...Pangea: The Rise and Fall of An Ancient Reef: Reef complexes stretched for hundreds of kilometers in what's now the Texas desert. (Part 3 of 6) (S)
...Pangea: A Tale of Tusks and Saber Teeth: In the Late Permian Period, increasingly mammal-like traits were gradually emerging in our ancient relatives. (Part 4 of 6) (S)
...Pangea: That Time Almost Everything Died: The Permian Period ended with the biggest mass extinction of all time; more than 80% of species vanished. (Part 5 of 6) (S)
...Pangea: Who Survived the Great Dying - and Why: Around 250 million years ago, at the dawn of the Triassic Period, life on Earth was devastated. (Part 6 of 6) (S)

Innovative, value-for-money products brought directly to you at home. Shop 'til you drop whilst avoiding the hustle and bustle of the High Street.
Faryion Wardrip was a typical, honest citizen on the outside, but a brutal serial killer on the inside. DNA testing proved to be his demise. S7, Ep19
Top-notch forensic science helps solve crimes. A car found on the road appears to have been abandoned suddenly. Later, the body of the driver is found... S7, Ep20

Top-notch forensic science helps solve real crimes. When the wife of a Presbyterian minister appears to have killed herself, police investigate whether it was suicide, or cold-blooded murder. S7, Ep21
Three years after the disappearance of a young woman, police uncover new evidence that only baffles them further. S7, Ep22
Innovative, value-for-money products brought directly to you at home. Shop 'til you drop whilst avoiding the hustle and bustle of the High Street.
A young dancer at a performing arts school falls in with the wrong crowd. Her sudden disappearance leads everyone to suspect her new friends. S7, Ep23
A successful businessman suffers a mysterious, debilitating illness. Tests enable toxicologists to save the man's life in the nick of time. S7, Ep24
A young traveller's hopes of hitting the ski fields are dashed after drugs are found, and at the International Mail Centre the war against 'P' goes on. S5, Ep2
Christchurch Customs intercept a gecko smuggler, a sick arrival sparks a medical emergency, and French coco packed full of illicit substances. S5, Ep3
A traveller with something spicy hidden in his trousers, a dodgy Christmas present, and MAF bio-security finds itself in a sticky situation. S5, Ep4
It's the biggest drug bust of the year for Customs, we meet the first Chinese Crocodile Dundee, and why is a returning student concealing large sums of cash? S5, Ep5
Emily Kaye was not aware of the past dealings of the handsome Patrick Mahon when she fell head over heels in love with him. S9, Ep6

p.t: UK Crime Files: The Murder Of An Author
p.d: Professor David Wilson explores the case of Ian Stewart, who murdered his fiancée Helen Bailey, concealing her body for months before being convicted of murder.

p.t: UK Crime Files: The Road Rage Killer
UK Crime Files: The Shoe Rapist
p.d: Simon Toyne travels to South Yorkshire to explore the bizarre case of a man dubbed 'The Rotherham Shoe Rapist', who left a town living in fear.

p.t: UK Crime Files: The Silent Assassin
p.d: Geoffrey Wansell explores how, in 1994, a waiter was shot dead in a Kirkwall restaurant. Suspect Michael Ross, 15, wasn't convicted until 2008 - 14 years later.
A broken finger, alleged love for hire, and a broken computer come into play when ex live-in lovers call it quits. S20, Ep198
Family drama takes to the street when an ex-con is accused of sucker punching a woman in front of her child; he claims his car was vandalized. S20, Ep199
When a man refuses to take a drug test at his sober living house, he is evicted and accused of property damage; he sues for emotional distress. S20, Ep200
When unwed parents fight over a car accident, a young mother's motivation for keeping her ex-lover's car in her name is called into question. S20, Ep201
A woman claims her boyfriend suffers from seizures and should never have taken her car; he admits he totalled the vehicle after a heated argument. S20, Ep202
A motorcycle shop owner for 17 years admits he didn't provide a much-needed estimate to family members trying to salvage an old bike. S20, Ep203
A man sues his cousin for trashing their shared apartment with a baseball bat; his cousin admits to heavy drinking and not remembering what happened. S20, Ep204
A man sues his ex-girlfriend for making unauthorized debit card charges while he was serving time for theft; she wants money for housesitting. S18, Ep15
After a heated argument, a woman demands that the father of her child leave their shared home; he claims she illegally kicked him out. S18, Ep16
A teenager starts to cry after her mother defends her behaviour on the court in court; her coach is sued for causing emotional distress. S18, Ep17
A woman is accused of being irrational and violent by her former roommate; they fight over a rent, damage and a restraining order. S18, Ep18
A catfight in a nightclub parking lot ends in a collision involving three vehicles; a security officer sues for damages to his car. S18, Ep19
A woman claims her ex-lover's furniture is being kept in storage as collateral for a loan she gave him to have his daughter's braces taken off. S18, Ep20

Summer: David Attenborough's visually stunning nature series. The sun never sets over summer in the polar regions. See how hordes of animals exploit this brief window of plenty.
Autumn: Witness how solar landscapes change as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some battle to breed and for a few it is a time of opportunity.
Winter: During winter most animals abandon the polar regions, but a few extreme survivors remain. This is the story of their battles to endure the planet's harshest winters.
The Last Frontier: The penultimate part of David Attenborough's acclaimed nature series. This episode looks at us humans, one of the polar regions' most ingenious inhabitants.
